items.note: White header with a hairline-divided account block, then a lemon header band with breadcrumb, a section-size title and one small cropped ID-card sticker at the right edge. Below that, a sidebar with a black current pill and underlined links, and one white ink-framed panel with 48px inputs and a pink save plus an outline reset. It reads like the reference's settings screen (07) and its product chrome (06); the hierarchy is clear and the hairlines are crisp.

The lemon band stacks breadcrumb, title and lead, with the sticker cropped at the edge, much like the reference's mobile product screen (10). The form panel keeps 48px ink-bordered fields and buttons that span the width. Only the sub-nav pill row is cruder than the reference: it wraps, leaving one item alone on a second line.

Dark grounds and 35% white hairlines. The current pill turns white, the lemon band and sticker stay exactly as in light, and the pink save stays. This follows the reference's dark appearance (11) faithfully; panels in black on the dark grey ground keep the drawn frame.

The dark mobile profile keeps the lemon band and sticker unchanged and gives the current pill a white fill. Panels and inputs are cleanly framed. It has the same wrapped sub-nav row as the light version.

A periwinkle header band with a bell sticker cropped at the edge. Two white panels are each divided by ink rules into rows of about 56px, with pink-on toggles. Grouping is one box with rules, not floating cards, which is close to the reference's hairline filter stack and toggle (06/07).

The band keeps its title, lead and a count line, with the sticker at the edge. The ruled toggle rows wrap their helper text cleanly at full width. The sub-nav pill row wraps with one orphan item, which is less tidy than the reference's single pill row.

Ruled panels go black with grey hairlines; toggles keep their pink-on state and the periwinkle band is unchanged. Chrome-only inversion as in the reference's dark appearance (11); rhythm and hierarchy are identical to the light version.
Dark mobile notifications: bands and stickers unchanged, the current pill is white, and the ruled rows are well spaced. It shares the wrapped sub-nav row.

A teal band with a lemon key sticker. Below it, a password panel with a pink update button, then an ink-framed sessions table with a paper header row, ruled rows, a status-dot chip and outline revoke actions. The language is right, but the password inputs sit at a fixed narrow width inside a full-width panel, leaving a large empty right half. The reference fills its panel or pairs it with a description column (07).

Full-width inputs and a full-width pink button sit in one framed panel. The sessions table scrolls inside its box with the first column sticky, as the spec says for tables under the md breakpoint. The sub-nav pill row wraps onto two lines.
Dark security keeps the teal band and the key sticker as in light, with black panels and grey hairlines. It has the same narrow inputs in a wide panel, which leaves an empty block on the right.
Dark mobile security has clean framed fields and a pink primary action that spans the width; the band is unchanged. The sub-nav pill row wraps.

Marigold band with a periwinkle disc-token sticker. Plan cards are ink-framed with notched pink price flags and ink check discs; the current plan has a pink selected border and check disc, much like the reference's option cards (07). The invoices table has a flag in each amount cell. The rhythm breaks with an oversized empty gap between the plan grid and the payment panel.

Plan cards stack in one column, each keeping its flag, checks and outline action; the selected card keeps its pink border. The invoice table scrolls inside its frame. The sub-nav pill row wraps with the current pill alone on the second line.

Dark billing: flags, the pink selected border and the band are unchanged, and the check discs invert to light. Chrome-only inversion as in the reference (11). It has the same oversized gap between the plans and the payment panel.
Dark mobile billing keeps flags and the pink selected card in clean stacked frames. The sub-nav pill row wraps.

findings.summary: On phones the settings sub-nav becomes a pill row that wraps, leaving one item alone on a second line. The underlined links also sit indented relative to the current pill, while the reference keeps its pill row on one line and aligned to the gutter.

The password fields are fixed at about a third of the width inside a full-width panel, leaving a large empty right half. The reference either fills the panel with its fields or pairs a narrow panel with a description column.

The gap between the plan-card grid and the payment panel is about 100px, much larger than the other gaps between panels, so the page loses its even rhythm. The reference keeps equal gaps between stacked panels.
